rows.note: Use this all-purpose spoken construction when an action or remark is performed in an ironic or sarcastic way.

example.english: They said ironically that they loved working overtime.
example.traditional: 佢諷刺咁話自己最鍾意加班。
example.jyutping: keoi5 fung3 ci3 gam3 waa6 zi6 gei2 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 gaa1 baan1

rows.note: Use this to introduce an ironic point about the situation being described rather than to modify a particular action.

example.english: Ironically, after everyone waited all night, the singer never showed up.
example.traditional: 諷刺嘅係，成班人等咗成晚，最後個歌手竟然冇出現。
example.jyutping: fung3 ci3 ge3 hai6 seng4 baan1 jan4 dang2 zo2 seng4 maan5 zeoi3 hau6 go3 go1 sau2 ging2 jin4 mou5 ceot1 jin6
